_comment: Reviewed label-only renames of proxy storage rows. The slot, offset and type are pinned: only the name changes, so the proxy layout is untouched. check-core-storage-layout.sh applies these to a baseline snapshot before it checks that the live layout extends it. Do not add entries for a moved or retyped variable.

renames.reason: SYS-1: a vaults-system contract names no gateway. The slot is retired (never written, never read) and keeps its position. The public getter gateway() is dropped from the ABI.
